title: Full One-Loop UV Structure: All Diagrams
description: Complete one-loop UV analysis for the Lambda0*Psi*R theory. SIM102 computed only the Psi self-energy from the graviton loop. SIM104 computes: (A) reproduction of SIM102 Psi self-energy, (B) graviton wavefunction renormalization from Psi loop, (C) vertex correction delta_Lambda0, (D) two-loop Psi self-energy. For each diagram: bare divergence power-law slope, regulated value with memory on graviton lines only, regulated value with memory on all lines. Determines whether UV-finiteness holds beyond the SIM102 one-loop partial result.

diagrams.A: Psi self-energy from graviton loop — graviton internal, memory on graviton line
diagrams.B: Graviton wavefunction renormalization from Psi loop — Psi internal, test both damping schemes
diagrams.C: Vertex correction delta_Lambda0/Lambda0 — via derivative of Sigma_A
diagrams.D: Two-loop Psi self-energy — leading Lambda0^4 contribution with two damped graviton loops

notes: SIM102 established Sigma(0) = Lambda0^2*k_m^4/(64pi^2) for diagram A only. The UV-finiteness conjecture requires all diagrams to be regulated. Key open question: does memory damping on graviton lines alone regulate the graviton self-energy (diagram B), or does Psi also need memory damping? Ward identity from diff invariance should enforce Pi_hh(0)=0; test numerically.
